description: dotcv stores your CVs. This app lets you read a CV, add or update work experience, education, projects, skills and languages, rewrite the summary, reorder sections, and get a link to download the finished CV as a PDF. Edits are made section by section against the revision you last read, so a change made in the dotcv editor or another session is reported rather than silently overwritten.

defaultPrompt: Add my latest job to my CV
Rewrite my CV summary for a senior backend role
Get a download link for my CV
